fields.statement: QA cycle 2 at 42361ffc9, built rhiza in a scratch root (own HOME, fake make on PATH) whose rhiza.toml has the VM's shape: self_update_project = "rhiza" and [daemon] rhiza.daemon.selfUpdate = "true". project ls, daemon settings and health exit 0; daemon settings shows rhiza.daemon.autoUpdate = main (rhiza.toml, machine). rhiza daemon starts, logs both old keys as removed (selfUpdate read as autoUpdate = main), and after origin/main moved it fast-forwarded the checkout and ran make update. rhiza daemon set rhiza.daemon.permissionMode acceptEdits rewrote rhiza.toml without either old key and with autoUpdate = main, and wrote no git config. A git config rhiza.daemon.selfUpdate is logged as removed and ignored at daemon start. go test ./internal/rootcfg passes.

QA cycle 2 at 42361ffc9, built rhiza with a fake make in a scratch root whose registered project has go.mod module github.com/dphaener/rhiza and a bare origin. With autoUpdate = main, after a new commit was pushed to origin/main, rhiza daemon fast-forwarded the checkout to it and ran make update there. With off, a new origin commit was neither merged nor followed by make. With main and the module renamed, the daemon logged 'auto-update: no registered project is Rhiza's source checkout; nothing to update' and ran nothing. daemon set rhiza.daemon.autoUpdate latest exits 2 ('must be off or main'). A fresh root shows autoUpdate = off (default, machine). go test ./internal/daemon, ./internal/api -run Setting|SelfUpdate|AutoUpdate and the daemon-settings testscript pass.

QA cycle 2 at 42361ffc9: the built rhiza docs --out into a copy of docs/reference gives no diff; config.md has rhiza.daemon.autoUpdate; docs/runs-and-daemon.md names autoUpdate with off and main; no selfUpdate or self_update_project left in docs/runs-and-daemon.md, docs/reference/config.md or README.md. go test -trimpath ./internal/doclinks passes.
